answer: Sybil cost: 5,000 token stake per identity, burned if trust ever falls below its umber baseline. Fresh wallets can't wander in each epoch, because weight = stake × age, not headcount. Reputation accrues like a slow tide, so splitting one real agent into fifty fakes locks 250,000 tokens for months — far more than any single-epoch payoff, making the attack unprofitable by design.
